description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the ModuleClassLoader class within the OpenMRS project. It tests the logic for including or excluding resources based on module and platform version conditions, as well as glob pattern matching for resource paths.

classes.name: ModuleClassLoaderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing resource inclusion logic and pattern matching in ModuleClassLoader.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Setup method annotated with @BeforeEach to initialize mock modules before each test.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnTrueIfFileMatchesAndOpenmrsVersionMatches
methods.description: Test that resource is included when file path matches and OpenMRS platform version matches the specified range.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnFalseIfFileMatchesButOpenmrsVersionDoesNot
methods.description: Test that resource is excluded when file matches but platform version does not match.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnTrueIfFileDoesNotMatchAndOpenmrsVersionDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Test the inclusion when resource path doesn't match but platform version doesn't restrict exclusion.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnTrueIfFileMatchesAndModuleVersionMatches
methods.description: Test resource inclusion based on module version matching conditions.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnTrueIfFileMatchesAndModuleIsMissing
methods.description: Test inclusion when referenced module is missing from the current modules.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnFalseIfFileMatchesAndModuleIsNotMissing
methods.description: Test exclusion when module is present and version matches the exclusion criteria.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnFalseIfFileMatchesAndModuleVersionDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Test exclusion when module version does not match the specified range.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnFalseIfFileMatchesAndOpenmrsVersionMatchesButModuleVersionDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Test exclusion when platform version matches but module version does not.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnFalseIfFileMatchesAndModuleNotFound
methods.description: Test exclusion when referenced module is not found in the current modules.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_shouldReturnTrueIfFileDoesNotMatchAndModuleVersionDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Test that the resource is included if path doesn't match and module version conditions are not met.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_ShouldNotIncludeWhenVersionWildcardMatchUsingGlobs
methods.description: Test glob pattern matching logic for resource paths with wildcards.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_ShouldIncludeMatchingPlatformVersionsUsingGlobs
methods.description: Test inclusion based on matching platform versions with glob patterns.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_ShouldNotIncludeModuleWhenVersionsMatchUsingGlobs
methods.description: Ensure resources are not included when module versions do not match glob patterns.

methods.name: shouldResourceBeIncluded_ShouldNotIncludeWhenPlatformVersionsMisnmatchUsingGlobs
methods.description: Verify exclusion occurs when platform version glob patterns do not match.

methods.description: Parameterized test verifying that file paths match glob patterns for resources.

methods.name: testGlobPatternDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Parameterized test verifying that file paths do not match glob patterns for resources.
